title: I let Apple’s always-listening AI summarize my life for two weeks
slides: Apple's always-listening AI: what did it hear?
It captured every conversation, meeting, and whisper
It flagged moments I'd forgotten—and one I wish it hadn't
Your iPhone may already be building a searchable memory of your day
Check your privacy settings today—before someone else does
thread_text:
1. It Heard Everything

Your iPhone's always-listening AI captured every conversation, meeting, and whisper. One user discovered it flagged moments they'd forgotten—and one they wish it hadn't.

2. The Unwanted Memory

The system surfaced a private exchange the user never intended to save. It's not a glitch—it's how the memory-building feature works by default.

3. A Searchable Day

Your phone may already be indexing your daily life into a searchable database. Every word you speak near it becomes a data point you can't delete.

4. The Privacy Blind Spot

Most users never checked what the AI stored. The settings that control this are buried, and the default favors data collection over your control.

5. Check Your Settings Now

Open your privacy settings today and review what your phone's AI has access to. If you haven't done it, start there—before someone else does.
